selection.stage1_rule: Compare only complete official Tuning coverage after one shared encoder pass per series. Final geometry may use timestamp-distinct support, locally calibrated radii, and label-blind state-transition consistency.
selection.stage2_rule: This diagnostic does not authorize Eval or parameter lock. A successful mechanism requires a separately frozen multi-seed Tuning protocol.
selection.dataset_specific_rule: All comparisons are dataset-specific; track fallback is forbidden.

diagnostic_axes.g1_independent_support: choose each observed representative after de-duplicating overlapping timestamp support
diagnostic_axes.g2_support_radius: penalize broad, strongly supported normal regions while keeping the legacy representative
diagnostic_axes.g3_support_radius_combined: combine timestamp-distinct representatives with support-calibrated local radii
diagnostic_axes.g4_support_radius_transition: add label-blind state-transition geometry to the combined memory

visual_evidence: raw normal and anomalous time-series intervals
selected observed prototypes with support, radius, and source time
